message.content: In the discussions regarding Red Dead Redemption 2, ThaneChambers mentioned several horse-related side quests that stood out to him. Specifically, he shared a memorable incident involving a "troubled" horse. ThaneChambers recounted, "There was this one time I accidentally scared it while trying to fight off a bear. It took off running, leaving me behind, and I ended up faceplanting in the mud. 🤣" This side quest seemed to be particularly amusing due to the mishap ThaneChambers experienced, highlighting the whimsical and sometimes chaotic nature of the horse interactions in the game.
